We distinguish these quantities using an Expert Subspace Separation Index (ESSI), matched-route residuals, and a prefix-controlled $2\times2$ factorial; frozen-route interventions and a controlled Top-$k$ study assess functional value. Three paired contrasts organize the findings. First, across six MoE architectures, expert subspaces overlap substantially, yet actual routes explain token representations better than matched alternatives. Second, across the 39 factorial cells in OLMoE, Mixtral, and DeepSeek, the selected candidate explains more of the residual representation than the strongest unselected rival in every cell, yet the actual prefix narrows this advantage throughout: all interactions are negative, and every 95% confidence interval lies below zero. Third, this geometric narrowing does not imply functional redundancy: adding later experts improves next-token prediction in 24 of 39 frozen-route comparisons, while the other 15 estimates are inconclusive; a controlled training study also favors Top-2 over Top-1 in all three seeds. We call this joint pattern coherent overlap: routing selects token-relevant experts from a shared geometric neighborhood, while useful multi-expert computation persists without disjoint linear coverage. Separating these quantities clarifies why geometric similarity alone cannot determine redundancy or pruning value.

</details>


### [392] [Measuring Distortion in the Empty Regions of Dimensionality Reduction Scatterplots with the Gap Index](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28324)
*Jaume Ros,Alessio Arleo,Fernando Paulovich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了 Gap Index (GI)，一种面向二维投影的质量度量指标，通过量化投影中空白区域（empty areas）的空间变形来捕捉视觉失真，弥补了传统度量仅关注点间关系（距离、邻域）而忽略空白区域结构失真的不足。GI 将二维空间分解为空三角形，与高维对应物比较以计算变形，结果可聚合为标量或叠加于投影上展示区域失真模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的降维投影质量度量（如距离保真度、邻域保持率等）几乎全部聚焦于点间直接关系，而忽视了投影布局中空白区域的结构变形。然而，这些空白区域往往构成二维布局中视觉上显著的特征，其失真同样会误导用户对数据结构的判断。因此需要一种能够捕捉空白区域空间变形的度量指标。

Method: 提出 Gap Index (GI)：首先将二维投影空间以数据点为顶点进行三角剖分（Delaunay 三角剖分），识别出空白区域的三角形；然后对每个空三角形，在高维空间中计算其对应点构成的三角形的几何变形程度（比较二维与高维三角形之间的结构差异）；最后，将逐三角形的变形值聚合为单一标量指标，或直接叠加在投影布局上以热力图形式可视化区域失真分布。

Result: 实验表明，Gap Index 对具有高视觉冲击力的小幅度结构变形高度敏感，而传统的流行质量度量对此类变形不敏感。此外，GI 计算速度快且具有良好的可解释性。

Conclusion: Gap Index 有效填补了现有投影质量度量在空白区域失真评估方面的空白，可作为传统点间关系度量的重要补充，为用户在高维数据可视化分析中提供更全面的置信度参考。

Abstract: Quality metrics play a crucial role in the proper use of dimensionality reduction projections for visual analysis of high-dimensional data. They quantify the degree of distortion of a projection compared to the high-dimensional data and provide a reliable indication of how confident users can be in the structures they see in the resulting layouts. However, most popular metrics focus on capturing direct relationships between points (e.g., distances or neighborhoods) while neglecting distortions in empty areas of the layout, even though these often compose visually relevant features of a 2D layout. In this paper, we introduce the Gap Index (GI), a quality metric for 2D projections that captures visual distortion by measuring spatial distortion in empty areas of a projection. It does so by decomposing the space into empty triangles, which are then compared to their high-dimensional counterparts to compute the deformation. This per-triangle deformation can be aggregated into a single scalar value or overlaid on a projection to visualize regional distortion patterns. Results show that, contrary to popular quality metrics, the GI is sensitive to small structural deformations that have high visual impact. It is also fast to compute and interpretable.

</details>


### [393] [LEDGERMIND: Provenance-Constrained Multimodal Agentic Reasoning with a Structured Evidence Ledger](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28374)
*Enjun Du,Hange Zhou,Chenxu Du,Siyi Liu,Zirong Chen,Ziyu Zheng,Yongqi Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LedgerMind，一种将多模态Agent轨迹建模为溯源约束状态机的框架，通过结构化证据账本、三层接地协议、自适应双路径调度器和事件驱动验证修复引擎，针对多模态视觉问答中答案正确但推理不可靠的隐性失效模式进行系统治理，在多个基准上同时提升答案准确率和轨迹忠实度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多模态Agent的VQA评估几乎只看最终答案准确率，这种聚合信号无法区分正确答案是源于扎实的证据接地、语言先验偏置还是偶然的错误抵消。作者识别出四种被准确率掩盖的典型失效模式：无支撑的中间推理、引用幻觉（Phantom Grounding）、简单查询的过度推理、以及修复阶段的溯源放大。

Method: LedgerMind将Agent轨迹构建为溯源约束状态机：(1) 工具输出被归一化为结构化证据账本（Structured Evidence Ledger），作为轨迹状态；(2) 下游推理和决策声明只能引用账本中的活跃条目；(3) 在实体级和数值级进行接地检查；(4) 修复操作被建模为类型化状态转换，且具备形式化的溯源非放大保证，禁止在无工具溯源的情况下引入新内容。此外集成了三层接地协议、按问题复杂度匹配推理深度的自适应双路径调度器、以及事件触发验证修复引擎。

Result: 在多个多模态推理基准和多种骨干MLLM上的实验表明，LedgerMind同时提升了答案准确率和轨迹级别的忠实度。

Conclusion: 通过对Agent轨迹施加溯源约束，以结构化证据账本为核心的状态机设计可有效消除多模态Agent中隐性但高危的推理失实问题，为超越最终答案的细粒度评估和可信Agent构建提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Multimodal agents for visual question answering increasingly operate as multi-step trajectories that interleave perception, retrieval, and reasoning, yet evaluation still largely reduces to final-answer accuracy. This aggregate signal cannot tell whether a correct answer was reached through grounded evidence, language priors, or accidental error cancellation. We propose to treat a multimodal agent trajectory as a provenance-constrained state machine: tool outputs are normalized into a Structured Evidence Ledger that serves as the trajectory state, downstream reasoning and decision claims may cite only active ledger entries, grounding is checked at the entity and numeric level, and repair is realized as typed state transitions that cannot introduce content without tool-produced provenance. We instantiate this design as LedgerMind (Provenance-Constrained Multimodal Agentic Reasoning with a Structured Evidence Ledger), augmented by a Three-Layer Grounding Protocol, an Adaptive Dual-Path Dispatcher that matches reasoning depth to question complexity, and an Event-Triggered Verification-and-Repair engine with a formal provenance non-amplification guarantee. We use LedgerMind to target four recurring failure patterns that final-answer accuracy tends to obscure: unsupported intermediate reasoning, citation-backed entity hallucination (Phantom Grounding), over-reasoning on simple queries, and repair-time amplification. Experiments across multiple multimodal reasoning benchmarks and backbone MLLMs show that LedgerMind improves both answer accuracy and trajectory-level faithfulness.

</details>


### [394] [Hierarchical Multilevel Monte Carlo for Order-Optimal Neural Actor-Critic in Average-Reward CMDPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28390)
*Ankur Naskar,Vaneet Aggarwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对平均奖励CMDP中神经critic的偏差-成本权衡问题，提出分层MLMC神经critic实现高效去偏，并基于此开发原始-对偶自然Actor-Critic算法，首次在无限时域平均奖励CMDP中实现$\tilde{O}(T^{-1/2})$阶最优收敛保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在安全关键的强化学习中，CMDP是核心框架，但将阶最优收敛保证扩展到使用神经critic的平均奖励CMDP一直悬而未决。核心瓶颈在于NTK分析下神经critic存在偏差-成本权衡：降低偏差会大幅增加优化成本，阻碍原始-对偶框架的阶最优收敛。

Method: 提出分层多级蒙特卡洛(MLMC)神经critic，在轨迹采样和critic优化两个层面同时进行去偏。该估计器以对数期望样本成本达到长时critic优化运行的偏差水平。在此基础上，开发原始-对偶自然Actor-Critic算法。

Result: 所提算法同时实现$\tilde{O}(T^{-1/2})$阶的最优性间隙和约束违反，且无需已知底层混合时间。该结果即使在无约束设定下也是新颖的。

Conclusion: 首次在无限时域平均奖励CMDP中，对一般策略参数化和神经critic建立了阶最优收敛保证，彻底解决了神经critic偏差-成本权衡这一根本性瓶颈。

Abstract: Constrained Markov Decision Processes (CMDPs) provide a natural framework for reinforcement learning in safety-critical applications, where agents maximize long-term reward while satisfying long-term constraints. Although primal-dual actor-critic methods with linear critics are well understood, extending order-optimal convergence guarantees to neural critics in average-reward CMDPs has remained open. The main challenge is a fundamental bias-cost trade-off in neural critic estimation: under Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) analysis, reducing critic bias substantially increases critic optimization cost, preventing order-optimal convergence in the primal-dual framework. We resolve this bottleneck by introducing a hierarchical Multilevel Monte Carlo (MLMC) neural critic that performs debiasing simultaneously across trajectory sampling and critic optimization. The resulting estimator attains the bias of a long critic optimization run with only logarithmic expected sample cost. Building on this estimator, we develop a primal-dual Natural Actor-Critic algorithm that achieves both an optimality gap and a constraint violation of order $\tilde{O}(T^{-1/2})$. This establishes the first order-optimal convergence guarantees for infinite-horizon average-reward CMDPs with general policy parameterization and neural critics, while eliminating the need to know the underlying mixing time. Our results are novel even in the unconstrained setting.

</details>


### [395] [Why Are GUI Agents Correct but Late? Decode on the Decision-Time Critical Path, Tested with Pre-Compiled Policy Trees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28399)
*Zihan Dong,Rui Qian,Qishi Zhan,Dongshen Peng,Kaixin Li,Yu Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AAPT通过在界面空闲期预构建条件策略树，消除了解码延迟，将GUI智能体在有争议决策窗口内的成功率从0.50提升至0.79，且不产生错误动作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有计算机使用智能体因自回归解码延迟过大致使动作执行滞后于瞬态GUI事件（窗口已关闭），需在不修改模型的前提下消除决策关键路径上的解码延迟。

Method: 提出自适应预判策略树（AAPT）：在屏幕空闲期，用冻结的多模态模型构建带可观测守卫、预授权动作和分支特定截止时间的有限条件策略树（大小覆盖模型自身解码延迟）；事件发生时，轻量观察器将变化门控帧匹配至预备分支并立即执行对应动作，无需文本生成。

Result: 配对试验中AAPT将成功率从0.50提升至0.79（p=1.8×10⁻³），零错误动作；开环与预测重规划基线均为零成功。延迟扫描显示收益出现在树规模规则预测的位置。消融实验揭示三个关键条件：快速观察器解码、有效树规划、准确分支路由。预注册oracle探针表明分支路由是因果瓶颈。在独立通用多模态模型126对试验中复现效果（p=4.9×10⁻¹³）。外部基准上AAPT与反应式基线总体性能相当但优势互补。

Conclusion: AAPT在候选动作可预先枚举时表现最佳，而反应式执行在无法枚举时更强；该方法通过将解码移出关键路径，为瞬态GUI交互提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Computer-use agents often fail on transient GUI events because they produce the correct action only after the relevant window has already closed. We identify the main cause as expensive autoregressive decoding on the decision-time critical path. We propose Adaptive Anticipatory Policy Trees (AAPT), which eliminates this delay without modifying the underlying model. During idle screen periods, the same frozen multimodal model constructs a bounded conditional policy tree with observable guards, pre-authorized actions, and branch-specific deadlines. The tree is sized to cover the model's own decoding latency. When an event occurs, a lightweight observer matches change-gated frames to a prepared branch and immediately executes the corresponding action without generating new text. In paired trials with pre-registered endpoints and exact McNemar tests, AAPT improves the success rate from 0.50 to 0.79 within a contested decision window ($p=1.8\times10^{-3}$), while producing no incorrect actions. Both open-loop and predict-and-replan baselines achieve zero success because they still decode during execution. A preparation-time sweep shows that the gain emerges where the latency-based tree-sizing rule predicts, and ablations reveal three key requirements: fast observer decoding, valid tree planning, and accurate branch routing. A pre-registered oracle probe rejects our initial hypothesis and instead points to branch routing as the causal bottleneck. We further reproduce the effect on an independent general-purpose multimodal model over 126 paired trials ($p=4.9\times10^{-13}$). On an external benchmark, AAPT matches the overall performance of a reactive baseline, although the two methods exhibit complementary strengths. Together, these results suggest that AAPT performs best when candidate actions can be enumerated in advance, whereas reactive execution remains stronger when they cannot.

</details>


### [396] [QQWorld: Quantile-Quantile Matching for World Model Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28415)
*Zhoushun Yu,Xiaoyu Hu,Xiangyu Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: QQWorld 提出用分位数-分位数（QQ）匹配替代 Epps-Pulley 目标来正则化世界模型的潜在分布，以解决尾部样本校正梯度消失问题，并通过跨批次 QQ 扩大排序池，在四个控制环境中提升了规划成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LeWorldModel (LeWM) 使用 Epps-Pulley (EP) 目标将潜在表示正则化为各向同性高斯分布，但 EP 对孤立尾部样本的校正梯度迅速消失，导致重尾偏差未能得到充分控制，限制了世界模型的规划性能。

Method: 提出 QQWorld：1）用分位数-分位数匹配目标替代 EP，将投影后的潜在样本与秩匹配的高斯分位数直接对齐，在尾部保持有效的校正梯度；2）开发跨批次 QQ 机制，利用之前批次的 detached 样本扩大有效排序池，并分析其偏差-方差权衡。

Result: 在四个控制环境中，QQWorld 有效提升了 LeWM 的平均规划成功率，同时一致性地实现了更好的高斯对齐和更薄的潜在尾部。

Conclusion: QQ 匹配正则化比 EP 目标更有效地约束潜在分布的尾部行为，跨批次机制进一步增强了这一优势，为世界模型的潜在空间规范化提供了更优方案。

Abstract: Latent world models enable efficient planning by predicting future states in a compact representation space, but their performance depends critically on the quality of the learned latent distribution. LeWorldModel (LeWM) regularizes its latents toward an isotropic Gaussian using the Epps-Pulley (EP) objective. We show that the corrective gradients of EP rapidly vanish for isolated tail samples, leaving heavy-tailed deviations insufficiently controlled. To address this limitation, we propose QQWorld, which replaces EP with a quantile-quantile matching objective that directly aligns projected latent samples with rank-matched Gaussian quantiles, thereby maintaining effective corrective gradients in the tails. We further develop cross-batch QQ, which enlarges the effective ranking pool using detached samples from previous batches, and characterize its bias-variance trade-off. Across four control environments, QQWorld effectively improves the average planning success rate of LeWM, while consistently yielding better Gaussian alignment and thinner latent tails.

</details>


### [397] [QAdapt: A Noise-Adaptive Neural Pre-Decoding Framework for Quantum Error Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28422)
*Ran Miao,Rui Luo,Xiaohan Shan,Xiaoming Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: QAdapt 是一种噪声自适应的神经预解码框架，通过捕获表面码纠错中局部时空相关性并持续适应动态噪声，在不改变后端解码器的前提下降低逻辑错误率和解码延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 容错量子计算不仅受物理噪声限制，还受经典解码器处理症候数据的延迟制约，尤其在强噪声、异构、非稳态硬件环境下，固定的神经解码器容易因仿真-硬件分布偏移而性能恶化。

Method: 提出 QAdapt 框架：捕获症候数据的局部时空相关性，顺序适应演化中的噪声条件并缓解灾难性遗忘，将残差症候转发给传统全局解码器。

Result: 在 110 种合成分布外噪声配置下，QAdapt 持续降低逻辑错误率；在 Google Willow 基准数据上，无需目标域微调即实现逻辑错误率最高降低 5.79%、后端解码延迟降低 9.32%。

Conclusion: QAdapt 提供了一种实用且与现有解码器兼容的方案，可提升量子纠错在动态硬件噪声下的鲁棒性和后端解码效率。

Abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC) relies on quantum error correction to suppress physical errors and preserve logical information at scale. In practice, however, performance is constrained not only by physical noise but also by the latency of classical decoders processing rapidly generated syndrome data. This challenge is exacerbated by hardware noise that is strong, heterogeneous, and nonstationary, as well as by the simulation-to-hardware distribution shift that can substantially degrade fixed neural decoders. We present QAdapt, a noise-adaptive neural pre-decoding framework for surface-code quantum error correction. QAdapt captures local spatiotemporal correlations in syndrome data, sequentially adapts to evolving noise conditions while mitigating catastrophic forgetting, and forwards the residual syndrome to a conventional global decoder. Across 110 synthetic out-of-distribution noise configurations for rotated surface-code memory circuits, QAdapt consistently reduces the logical error rate relative to the neural pre-decoding baseline. On Google's Willow benchmark data, without target-domain fine-tuning, it achieves reductions of up to 5.79 percent in logical error rate and 9.32 percent in backend decoding latency on the residual syndrome. These results demonstrate that QAdapt provides a practical and decoder-compatible approach to improving the robustness and backend decoding efficiency of quantum error correction under evolving hardware noise.

</details>


### [398] [Kohn-Sham Spectral Embedding on Sparse Graphs at the Nishimori Temperature for Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28428)
*V. S. Usatyuk,D. A. Sapozhnikov,S. I. Egorov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出KSSE——一种物理启发的能量模型，用稀疏图谱嵌入替代密集CNN分类器，在ImageNet-1000上以约21M参数实现88.93% Top-1精度，比肩ViT-H/14（632M），参数减少30倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统CNN分类器依赖密集全连接层，参数效率低；作者希望借鉴Kohn-Sham密度泛函理论和随机键Ising模型的物理洞察，将分类任务转化为稀疏图上的谱问题，大幅降低参数量同时保持竞争力。

Method: 将预训练特征映射到准循环LDPC图上，构建正则化Laplacian作为Kohn-Sham哈密顿量；利用循环块FFT（基于Z/pZ的Pontryagin自对偶性）和低阶Rayleigh精炼，在O(N log N + k²N)时间内求解D个独立通道谱问题。通过"星域手术"优化图拓扑，以边移位替代删除受挫环，构造局部凸性并约束残余受挫。结合多尺度分形分析和分形学习率景观，从粗糙域过渡到星域盆地，实现k_mode=5的Rayleigh精炼。给出六项理论证明：广义Ihara-Bass恒等式、陷阱集-特征值对应、加性通道可分离性及交换-关联界、手术定理、拟平稳扰动界和不动点收敛定理。

Result: 在ImageNet-1000上使用冻结EfficientNet-B4特征（D=1792）的转导协议中，KSSE以约21.24M参数实现88.93% Top-1精度，超越Swin-L（197M，86.4-87.3%），与ViT-H/14（632M，88.0-89.5%）持平，模型体积分别减少10倍和30倍。

Conclusion: KSSE通过物理启发的稀疏图谱嵌入，在极小参数量下实现了与巨型视觉Transformer相当的分类精度，证明了密度泛函理论思想与图信号处理结合在大规模分类任务中的有效性和参数效率。

Abstract: We introduce Kohn--Sham Spectral Embedding (KSSE), a physics-inspired energy-based model replacing dense CNN classifiers with a sparse-graph spectral embedding evaluated at the Nishimori temperature of an associated Random-Bond Ising Model. By mapping pre-trained features onto quasi-cyclic low-density parity-check graphs and constructing a regularized Laplacian acting as a Kohn--Sham Hamiltonian, we solve $D$ independent channel spectral problems in $\mathcal{O}(N\log N + k^2_{\text{mode}} N)$ time via FFT on circulant blocks (leveraging Pontryagin self-duality of $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$) and low-order Rayleigh refinement. Graph topology is optimized using \emph{star-domain surgery}: rather than destroying information-carrying codewords by removing frustrated cycles, we construct edge shifts creating local convexity around codewords while bounding residual frustration to $ρ(B_γ)\leq 1+δ$. Multi-scale fractal analysis ($D_2$ spectrum) and fractal learning-rate landscape certifies a landscape transition from rough regimes ($D_2>3$) to star-domain basins ($D_2<1$), enabling Rayleigh refinement with $k_{\text{mode}}=5$ modes. We prove six theoretical results: a generalized Ihara--Bass identity linking belief propagation to the Laplacian; trapping-set eigenvalue correspondence; additive channel separability with an explicit exchange-correlation bound; a surgery theorem bounding frustration with attractor width $Ω(1/\sqrt{d_{\min}})$; a quasi-stationarity perturbation bound; and a fixed-point convergence theorem. In a transductive protocol on ImageNet-1000 with frozen EfficientNet-B4 features ($D=1792$), KSSE achieves \textbf{88.93\%} Top-1 accuracy using $\approx 21.24$M parameters, outperforming Swin-L (197M, 86.4--87.3\%) and matching ViT-H/14 (632M, 88.0--89.5\%) under standard inductive setups, while reducing model footprint by $10\times$ and $30\times$, respectively.

</details>


### [399] [Oracle-Budgeted Molecular Optimization with Short-Term Graph Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28437)
*Jiannan Yang,Veronika Thost,Xiang Ling,Tengfei Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种名为"短期图记忆"（short-term graph memory）的即插即用模块，用于在有限oracle预算下提升分子优化效率。该模块通过在线图神经网络代理模型预筛选候选分子，使固定预算集中用于预测效用更高的分子，从而在不增加额外oracle成本的情况下提升生成器的优化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子优化通常受限于有限的oracle调用预算（如湿实验或高精度模拟），因此决定"评估什么"与决定"生成什么"同等重要。现有分子生成器缺乏对历史评估信息的有效利用来指导后续查询选择，需要在固定预算内更智能地分配oracle调用。

Method: 提出短期图记忆模块，作为一个保持生成器架构和原生更新规则不变的插件。核心机制是维护一个在线图神经网络（GNN）代理模型，在每轮对候选分子池进行预筛选，预测其效用分数，优选出高潜力分子提交给oracle评估。该模块可与任意分子生成器集成，实验中将此模块应用于基于片段的生成器及其他四种生成器，在标准分子优化基准上进行评估。

Result: 在标准分子优化基准上，该模块在不增加oracle成本的前提下提升了平均top-10分数，且在任何oracle预算下均不劣于基线。在仅1000次调用的严格预算下，四个测试的生成器均获得性能增益。进一步分析揭示了代理引导选择与不同生成器探索-利用行为的交互规律：在较大预算下的获益程度与生成器的搜索广度及原生搜索利用oracle反馈的有效性相关。

Conclusion: 提出了一种简单有效的方法，通过在固定oracle预算下实现更选择性的分子评估，提升分子优化效率，并给出了关于哪些类型的生成器能从该模块中获益的证据和指导。

Abstract: Molecular optimization is commonly performed under a limited oracle budget, which makes deciding what to evaluate as important as deciding what to generate. We introduce short-term graph memory, a plug-in module that preserves the generator architecture and native update rule while learning from previously evaluated molecules to prioritize subsequent oracle queries. The module maintains an online graph neural surrogate that pre-screens each round's candidate pool, so the fixed oracle budget is spent on molecules with higher predicted utility. Applied to a fragment-based generator on a standard molecular optimization benchmark, it improves the mean top-10 score at no extra oracle cost and never falls behind the base on any oracle; the gain extends to all four generators we tested at a tight budget of one thousand calls. We then analyze how surrogate-guided selection interacts with the exploration and exploitation behavior of different generators. Its benefit at larger budgets is consistent with two properties of the backbone: how broadly it searches, and how effectively its native search already exploits oracle feedback. We provide a simple way to spend a fixed oracle budget more selectively, and evidence on which generators benefit from it.

</details>


### [400] [Cybersecurity Detection Classification with Reasoning-enabled Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28460)
*Amol Khanna,Manu Nandan,Cristian Viorel Popa,Joan Pujol-Roig,Diana Bolocan,Laura Vasilie,Alexandru Apostu,Chase Helwig,Mihaela Gaman,Michael Brautbar,Edward Raff,Chase Midler,Sven Krasser*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对SOC告警疲劳问题，提出一种具备思维链推理能力的告警三分类器，通过结合自动提示优化、自训练和可验证奖励的强化学习进行训练，并额外训练校准器解决推理对标签概率的退化影响，在真实Windows端点检测数据上显著超越直接标签的LLM分类器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全运营中心（SOC）面临严重的告警疲劳问题——每日检测告警数量远超分析人员处理能力。现有方法仅让大语言模型直接输出三分类标签，但未训练模型推理检测是否为真实威胁，导致分类决策缺乏可解释性和可靠性。

Method: 提出三阶段训练框架：(1) 自动提示优化（Automated Prompt Optimization）生成高质量思维链提示；(2) 自训练（Self-training）利用模型自身生成推理轨迹扩充训练数据；(3) 基于可验证奖励的强化学习优化推理质量。针对CoT推理导致标签token概率退化的问题，额外训练一个校准器（Calibrator），读取完整推理轨迹并估计判决正确的概率。

Result: 在真实人工标注的Windows端点检测数据集上，系统达到82.6%测试准确率。在高置信度自动化三分类操作点下，相比直接标签LLM分类器，良性召回率提升43.0%，恶意召回率提升18.3%。消融实验表明：(1) 未训练的置信度评判器会使高置信度召回率降为零，证明校准器不可或缺；(2) 微调30B模型显著优于前沿通用大模型，说明定向训练优于单纯扩大规模。

Conclusion: 思维链推理可有效提升安全告警三分类的性能和可解释性，但必须配合专门的校准机制才能在实际自动化三分类中发挥作用。定向微调中等规模模型比直接使用更大规模的通用模型更有效，为SOC自动化三分类提供了实用路径。

Abstract: A major issue in Security Operations Centers (SOCs) is alert fatigue, as the number of detections reported is more than staff can triage in a given day. Prior work prompts or fine-tunes large language models (LLMs) to emit a triage label directly, but does not train them to reason about whether a detection is a genuine threat. We train a chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning-enabled triage classifier on real, human-labeled Windows endpoint detections by combining automated prompt optimization, self-training, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. We find that CoT reasoning also degrades the label-token probabilities that automated triage relies on, so we separately train a calibrator that reads the full reasoning trace and estimates the probability that the verdict is correct. Our system reaches 82.6% test accuracy and, at the high-confidence operating point that governs automated triage, improves benign recall by 43.0% and malicious recall by 18.3% over a direct-label LLM classifier. We further show that the trained calibrator is necessary - an untrained confidence judge collapses high-confidence recall to zero - and that a finetuned 30B model significantly outperforms frontier general-purpose models, motivating targeted training over scale.

</details>


### [401] [The Role of Causality in Algorithmic Recourse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28497)
*Srikanth Avasarala,Varun Gupta,Shahin Jabbari,Saber Salehkaleybar,Juba Ziani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种因果执行框架来形式化算法追索中的失败模式，建模追索行动如何通过结构因果模型传播，揭示忽视因果结构的追索策略会引发策略性博弈，而因果追索能实现稳定均衡并减少模型重复训练的需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有算法追索方法仅关注翻转模型预测，未考虑推荐行动是否真正改善个体的真实资质，还是仅仅促使个体策略性地"博弈"分类器。这导致部署后的追索政策引发行为响应，降低预测准确性，并在模型重训练后失效。

Method: 作者构建了一个因果执行框架（causal performative framework），通过结构因果模型（SCM）对追索行动的传播进行建模，捕捉特征间交互及其对真实标签的影响。在此框架下，将问题形式化为一个非凸优化问题，并刻画了执行稳定解（performatively stable solutions）存在的条件，提出通过简单迭代动力学高效求解的方法。

Result: 理论分析表明忽视因果结构的追索政策会引发大规模、错位的行为响应；而因果追索能够实现稳定均衡，降低博弈激励。在半合成和真实信用数据集上的实验表明，该方法一致优于标准经验风险最小化（ERM），同时减少了因策略性智能体行为导致的分布偏移所需重复模型重训练。

Conclusion: 因果追索方法通过引入因果结构，有效解决了传统追索政策引发的策略性博弈和预测性能退化问题，实现了稳定均衡，并为高风险分类场景中的追索机制设计提供了更可靠的方案。

Abstract: Algorithmic recourse aims to provide individuals with actionable changes to improve their predicted outcomes in high-stakes classification settings, such as loan and mortgage applications. However, most existing approaches focus only on flipping a model's prediction, without accounting for whether the recommended changes lead to genuine improvement in an individual's true qualifications or merely enable strategic gaming of the classifier. Consequently, deployed recourse policies can induce behavioral responses that degrade predictive accuracy and become ineffective after model retraining.
  In this work, we formalize this failure mode through a causal performative framework for recourse. We model how recourse actions propagate through a structural causal model, capturing interactions among features as well as their effect on the true label. These causal responses induce a non-convex optimization problem, even under standard convex losses. We characterize conditions under which performatively stable solutions exist and can be efficiently computed via simple iterative dynamics. Our analysis reveals that recourse policies that ignore causal structure can induce large, misaligned behavioral responses, whereas causal recourse leads to stable equilibria that reduce incentives for gaming. Experiments on both semi-synthetic and real credit datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms standard empirical risk minimization while reducing the need for repeated model retraining to accommodate distribution shifts caused by strategic agent behavior.

</details>


### [402] [Same Graph Cross-Task Transfer in GNNs: Protocols and Predictors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28525)
*Neelam Akula,Surbhi Kumar,Murat Kantarcioglu,Baris Coskunuzer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文形式化了同图节点分类（NC）与链路预测（LP）之间的跨任务迁移问题，提出了一个无数据泄漏的评估协议，发现迁移方向性强：NC→LP在同配图中始终有益，而LP→NC仅在结构主导机制下可靠；并提出CoTask Score（CTS）度量联合任务效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多真实图在同一底层结构上同时支持NC和LP任务，但现有评估由于不兼容的数据划分、观测图假设和负采样规则不一致，导致同图跨任务迁移的结论不可靠。本文旨在建立可靠、可复现的评估框架来研究NC-LP迁移规律。

Method: 作者提出无泄漏协议：固定节点和边的划分，使用排除被评估边的共享消息传递图，并为LP采用固定负采样。在此协议下，使用GCN、GraphSAGE、GPS三种骨干网络，系统评估NC→LP和LP→NC两种迁移方向的性能。还引入CoTask Score（CTS）来总结共享编码器同时服务两个任务时的联合效用。

Result: NC→LP在同配图上始终有益；LP→NC的迁移脆弱，朴素表示复用甚至会降低准确率；LP→NC仅在“LP容易但NC未饱和”的结构主导机制下才可靠正向，表明LP可视为结构预训练。简单的数据集统计量（尤其是同配性）可指导机制选择并避免负迁移。

Conclusion: 同图NC-LP迁移具有强方向性和可预测性，NC→LP普遍有益，LP→NC需谨慎使用；同配性是决定迁移策略的关键指标；CTS可作为多任务共享编码器的有效评估工具。

Abstract: Many real-world graphs support multiple predictive tasks over the same underlying structure, creating an opportunity to reuse supervision across node classification (NC) and link prediction (LP). However, existing evaluations often rely on incompatible splits, observed-graph assumptions, and negative sampling rules, making conclusions about same-graph cross-task transfer unreliable. We formalize same-graph NC-LP transfer and propose a leakage-free protocol that fixes node and edge splits, uses a shared message-passing graph that excludes evaluated edges, and employs fixed negatives for LP. Across three backbones (GCN, GraphSAGE, GPS), we find that transfer is strongly directional and predictable: NC $\to$ LP is consistently beneficial on homophilic graphs, while LP $\to$ NC is fragile and can even degrade accuracy under naive representation reuse. LP $\to$ NC becomes reliably positive mainly in a structure-dominant regime where LP is easy but NC is unsaturated, suggesting that LP acts as structural pretraining. Finally, we introduce the CoTask Score (CTS) to summarize joint NC+LP utility when a shared encoder must serve both tasks, and show that simple dataset statistics, especially homophily, can guide mechanism choice and help avoid negative transfer.

</details>


### [403] [APO: Unsupervised Atomic Policy Optimization for 3D Structure Prediction of Atomic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28553)
*Shentong Mo,Yatao Bian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Atomic Policy Optimization (APO)，一种无需真实结构标签的无监督对齐框架，通过群体相对策略优化与双奖励机制（潜在结构模式奖励+热力学稳定性奖励），使模型能自我纠正并生成物理合理的3D原子结构，在晶体和抗体结构预测上超越全监督基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的流匹配模型（如FlowDPO）依赖监督偏好学习与真实坐标对齐，但在新晶体相或从头蛋白质设计中获取实验标签极其昂贵，数据稀缺场景下结构建模面临瓶颈。因此需要一种无需真实参考结构的无监督对齐方法。

Method: 提出APO框架：(1) 将群体相对策略优化（Group-Relative Policy Optimization）适配到3D原子环境；(2) 设计双奖励机制——通过样本相似度的特征分解强化策略主导潜在结构模式的奖励，以及约束热力学稳定性的奖励；(3) 在采样群体中识别物理合理构型实现模型自我纠正；(4) 有效拉直概率路径以提升推理效率。

Result: 在晶体和抗体结构预测的广泛基准上，APO一致地超越全监督基线，在匹配率和结构保真度上达到新的最优水平，同时显著提升推理效率。

Conclusion: 内在物理一致性可作为比噪声监督坐标匹配更优的对齐引导信号，APO为数据稀缺场景下的原子结构预测提供了有效的无监督解决方案。

Abstract: Predicting the 3D structures of atomic systems is fundamental to advancing material science and drug discovery. While flow-matching models (, FlowDPO) have recently shown promise in this domain, their performance relies heavily on alignment with ground-truth coordinates via supervised preference learning. However, obtaining experimental labels for novel crystal phases or de novo proteins is prohibitively expensive, creating a bottleneck for structural modeling in data-scarce regimes. In this work, we propose (Atomic Policy Optimization), a fully unsupervised alignment framework that eliminates the need for ground-truth reference structures. APO adapts group-relative policy optimization to 3D atomic environments, utilizing a novel dual-reward mechanism: (i) a that reinforces the policy's dominant latent structural modes through eigen-decomposition of sample similarities, and (ii) a that enforces thermodynamic stability. Our framework enables the model to ``self-correct'' by identifying physically plausible configurations within sampled groups. Extensive benchmarks on crystal and antibody structure prediction demonstrate that APO consistently outperforms fully supervised baselines, achieving a new state-of-the-art in match rates and structural fidelity. Furthermore, we show that APO effectively straightens probability paths, significantly improving inference efficiency. Our results suggest that intrinsic physical consistency can serve as a superior guide for alignment compared to noisy, supervised coordinate matching.

</details>


### [404] [$β$-OPSD: Deriving with Policy Optimization, Training with Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28582)
*Jiawei Xu,Minghui Liu,Juzheng Zhang,Tom Goldstein,Furong Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示标准在线策略自蒸馏(OPSD)本质上是更广泛策略优化族中β=1的特例，提出β-OPSD框架，通过可调节的KL惩罚权重β实现参考策略与特权教师之间的几何插值，并利用闭式解作为蒸馏目标来高效逼近RL最优解，在数学推理任务上稳定优于原始OPSD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始OPSD在实践中表现脆弱，常需大量工程调整才能稳定工作。作者旨在从结构层面诊断这一问题的根源——β参数被隐式固定为1，缺乏对参考策略与教师引导之间权衡的控制能力。

Method: 1. 将OPSD推广为β-OPSD，引入加权KL惩罚项β·KL(π||π_ref)，推导其最优策略为参考策略与特权教师的几何插值；2. 不直接优化高成本、高方差的RL目标，而是将闭式解转化为蒸馏目标，通过token级logits混合高效实现；3. 采用return-to-go信用分配机制，使token级更新与序列级目标对齐。

Result: 在数学推理基准测试上，β-OPSD在优化稳定性和下游推理性能方面一致优于原始OPSD，且保持了OPSD的计算效率优势。

Conclusion: β-OPSD提供了一条从自蒸馏到策略优化再回归的有原则路径，通过调节β在参考策略忠诚度与教师引导之间取得灵活平衡，在不牺牲效率的前提下显著提升OPSD的可靠性和性能。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) is a promising approach to improve reasoning language models, but it remains brittle in practice: making it work reliably often requires substantial engineering effort. We identify a structural source of this difficulty: vanilla OPSD is precisely the $β=1$ member of a broader policy-optimization family, where $β$ weights the KL penalty anchoring the student to a reference policy. This equivalence turns $β$ from an implicit value fixed at one into a controllable regularization parameter, yielding a more general formulation that trades off proximity to a reference policy against privileged teacher guidance. We introduce $β$-OPSD and derive its optimal policy as a geometric interpolation between the reference policy and the privileged teacher. Directly optimizing this objective with reinforcement learning, however, would be costly and high-variance. Rather than optimize the RL objective directly, we turn its closed-form solution into a distillation target. Each value of $β$ selects a target along the reference-to-teacher path, which we implement efficiently by mixing their token-level logits. In this way, inexpensive distillation approximates the solution of expensive policy optimization. Return-to-go credit assignment further aligns token updates with the sequence-level objective while retaining the simplicity of OPSD. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that $β$-OPSD consistently outperforms vanilla OPSD, improving optimization stability and downstream reasoning performance. Our results provide a principled route from self-distillation to policy optimization and back without sacrificing the efficiency that makes OPSD practical.

</details>


### [405] [KAISEN: Reproducible Subgroup Fairness Auditing for Clinical Risk Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28608)
*Sparsh Roy,Samuel Girmachew,Nishita Chavan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了KAISEN审计流水线，包含子群分层、差异度量、机制诊断、事后缓解和漂移监测五个阶段，在合成基准上对其进行压力测试至失效点，揭示了四个关键发现：统计显著性与标准化效应量的秩相关、阈值优化优于概率校准、代理误设导致机制诊断失效、以及CUSUM漂移检测的阈值不可跨队列迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床风险模型在不同患者子群中常产生显著差异的错误率，现有审计流水线的各组件缺乏系统性的压力测试，使用者无法判断审计工具的可靠性和适用条件。

Method: 设计KAISEN五阶段审计流水线（子群分层→差异度量→机制诊断→事后缓解→漂移监测），在包含16个疾病任务、15个健康人群2030社会决定因素轴及3个预设交叉维度的合成基准上，系统性地将每个组件测试至失效点。

Result: 获得四项核心发现：(i)显著性与每个轴的最小可检测效应相关——显著性计数与原始等化几率差(EOD)的秩相关系数为0.56，经最小可检测效应标准化后提升至0.78；(ii)逐组阈值优化在48/48次留出运行中降低EOD（配对Δ=-0.285, 95%CI [-0.313,-0.252]），而组级Platt缩放仅19/48次改善EOD，均值效应接近零；(iii)机制诊断在144例受控案例中全部分类正确，但在代理误设下48例模型驱动案例中零恢复且无失败信号；(iv)CUSUM误报和漏报与疾病本身关联弱，主要受队列实现影响——同一阈值下27次误报和7/8次漏检漂移均来自不同随机种子(p=0.002)。

Conclusion: 审计流水线各组件存在系统性脆弱性：统计显著性检验受限于检测底线、事后缓解方法的选择显著影响效果、机制诊断对代理变量误设高度敏感、漂移检测阈值缺乏跨队列可迁移性。建议审计实践中应报告方差而非均值，并针对具体条件验证每个组件。所有结果为合成数据，不构成临床有效性声明。

Abstract: Clinical risk models routinely achieve strong aggregate performance while producing materially different error rates across patient subgroups. Audit pipelines have been proposed to catch this, but their components are rarely stress-tested, so it is unclear which parts of an audit can be trusted and under what conditions. We present KAISEN, a five-phase audit pipeline covering subgroup stratification, disparity measurement, mechanism diagnostics, post-hoc mitigation, and drift monitoring, evaluated to the point of failure on a synthetic benchmark of 16 disease tasks, 15 social-determinant axes from Healthy People 2030, and three prespecified intersections. Four findings follow. (i) Significance tracks each axis's gap against its own minimum detectable effect: rank correlation between significance count and raw equalized-odds difference (EOD) across the 15 axes is rho = 0.56, rising to rho = 0.78 once EOD is standardized by that floor. (ii) Per-group threshold optimization reduces EOD in 48 of 48 held-out runs (paired delta = -0.285, 95% CI [-0.313, -0.252]), while group-wise Platt scaling -- the better calibrator -- behaves as a coin flip on EOD (19 of 48 runs improved, 95% CI [0.26, 0.55]) with mean effect near zero, so what an audit should report is the variance, not the average. (iii) The mechanism diagnostic classifies 144 of 144 controlled cases correctly but recovers none of 48 model-driven cases under proxy misspecification, with no signal that it failed. (iv) CUSUM failures and false alarms track cohort realization far more than disease: at the reference threshold, all 27 false alarms and 7 of 8 missed shifts come from different seeds (chi-squared p = 0.002), so a threshold tuned on one cohort fails to transfer. All results are synthetic with known ground truth and do not establish clinical validity. Code, artifacts, and scripts reproducing every number are released.

</details>


<div id='stat.ME'></div>

# stat.ME [[Back]](#toc)

### [406] [Power-Optimal Covariate Adjustment for Switchback Experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27376)
*Sergei Pankratev*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 针对轮换实验中不等聚类规模导致的估计量方差膨胀问题，提出了一种功率最优的CUPAC方差缩减方法，通过区分并平衡随机化单元间与单元内的噪声预测，在结果预测和分析残差化两个阶段进行适配，以最大化统计功效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在轮换实验中，当聚类规模不相等时，结果在随机化单元间的离散性会膨胀估计量方差并限制统计功效。标准CUPAC方法以整体预测精度为目标，未能区分随机化单元间和单元内的方差分量，而这些分量对估计量方差的贡献不等，导致方差缩减效果次优。

Method: 提出一种功率最优的CUPAC方差缩减方法：(1) 利用轮换实验处理效应估计量的方差分解框架；(2) 在结果预测阶段和分析时残差化阶段分别进行适配，平衡随机化单元间与单元内的噪声预测；(3) 以最小化处理效应方差为目标进行优化。通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证理论框架，并讨论实际应用中的效率增益和局限性。

Result: 建立了功率最优CUPAC的理论框架，并通过广泛的蒙特卡洛模拟研究验证了该框架的有效性。该方法能够在不等聚类规模的轮换实验中实现比标准CUPAC更高的统计功效。

Conclusion: 所提出的功率最优CUPAC方法通过精细区分方差来源并针对性优化，显著提升了轮换实验在不等聚类规模条件下的方差缩减效率，具有明确的实用价值，但也存在一定局限性需要在实际应用中加以考虑。

Abstract: In switchback experiments with unequal cluster sizes, outcome dispersion across randomization units inflates estimator variance and limits statistical power. Standard control-using-prediction-as-covariate (CUPAC) adjustment may be suboptimal for variance reduction in this setting, because in its basic form it targets overall predictive accuracy and does not distinguish between the components of variance that vary across the randomization units of switchback experiments and those that vary across individual observations, even though these components contribute unequally to estimator variance. We propose a power-optimal variance reduction methodology via CUPAC that balances prediction of the noise between and within randomization units to achieve maximum statistical power. The methodology utilizes the framework for decomposition of the variance of the treatment-effect estimator for switchback experiments, and adapts both the outcome prediction and the analysis-time residualization to minimize the treatment-effect variance. The study first develops the theoretical framework for the power-optimal CUPAC. We then validate the theoretical framework through an extensive Monte Carlo simulation study. Finally, we discuss the practical considerations of the proposed methodology, including its potential efficiency gains and limitations.

</details>


### [407] [A New Measure of Dependence Between Continuous and Multinomial Random Variables](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27381)
*Lu Yang,Galin L. Jones*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于Hellinger距离的新型相依性度量，用于衡量连续随机变量与多项随机变量之间的依赖关系，并开发了基于数据分割和核密度估计的估计方法，其渐近分布简单且收敛速率为√n。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的相依性度量通常需要对连续变量做出特定分布假设，或假设离散变量源于潜在连续变量。本文旨在提出一种无需此类假设、且满足理想度量标准的新方法。

Method: 提出基于条件分布之间Hellinger距离的相依性度量；采用数据分割（data splitting）与核密度估计（kernel density estimation）相结合的方法构建估计量；推导该估计量的渐近分布。

Result: 新度量满足相依性度量的理想准则，无需对连续变量做分布假设，也不假设离散变量来自潜在连续变量。估计量具有√n的收敛速率，渐近分布形式简单，使得置信区间构建和独立性检验变得直接且计算便捷。

Conclusion: 该基于Hellinger距离的相依性度量在混合数据类型（连续-离散）场景下具有理论严谨性和实际可操作性，为相关统计推断提供了有效工具。

Abstract: A novel measure of dependence between a continuous random variable and a multinomial random variable is introduced. The proposed measure is based on the Hellinger distance between conditional distributions. It satisfies the desiderata for a dependence measure without making specific distributional assumptions about the continuous random variable or assuming that the discrete random variable arises from a latent continuous random variable. An estimator of the dependence measure based on data splitting and kernel density estimation is developed. The asymptotic distribution of the estimator has a simple form with a convergence rate of \sqrt{n}, making confidence intervals for the dependence measure and a test for independence straightforward and computationally convenient.

</details>


### [408] [Handling Missingness and Censoring in Dirichlet Mixture Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27403)
*Jason Pillay,Andriette Bekker,Cristina Tortora,Antonio Punzo*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文针对不完全成分数据提出了一种基于EM算法的有限Dirichlet混合模型拟合方法，可在单纯形上直接处理缺失和删失成分，同时进行参数估计与插补，在模拟和两个真实数据集上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的成分数据分析方法通常要求完整观测值，面对缺失或删失成分时，研究者往往只能删除部分观测或转换到无约束空间，损害了可解释性和成分结构的一致性。因此需要一种在单纯形上直接处理不完全成分数据的似然方法。

Method: 提出基于EM算法的有限Dirichlet混合分布拟合方法，直接在单纯形上处理缺失和随机删失成分，实现参数估计与基于模型的插补同步进行，保持成分结构的可解释性。通过模拟实验评估不同复杂删失机制下的估计和聚类性能，并与案例删除策略对比模型选择效果。

Result: 模拟实验表明，即使观测不完全，所提方法仍具有良好的聚类性能，且模型选择指标识别正确聚类数的概率显著高于案例删除策略。在捕虏岩数据集上识别出四成分Dirichlet混合模型，揭示了岩石类型和形成方法的可解释轮廓；在PM2.5成分数据上支持四成分混合模型，刻画了全美颗粒物成分组成特征。

Conclusion: 所提出的EM型算法能够在不离开单纯形的前提下有效处理不完全成分数据，兼顾参数估计与插补，在聚类和模型选择方面均优于传统的案例删除方法，具有明确的实用价值。

Abstract: Incomplete compositional data analysis faces a fundamental limitation: likelihood-based methods for compositional models generally require fully observed compositions, making it difficult to accommodate missing or censored proportions directly on the simplex. Consequently, analysts often discard partially observed compositions or transform the data into unconstrained spaces, potentially sacrificing interpretability and coherence. This paper proposes a likelihood-based method for incomplete compositional data without leaving the simplex. Specifically, we develop an Expectation-Maximisation (EM) type algorithm for fitting finite mixtures of Dirichlet distributions in the presence of missing and censored components. The proposed approach performs parameter estimation and model-based imputation simultaneously while preserving the compositional structure and interpretability of the original variables.
  A simulation experiment evaluates the performance of the proposed estimators and imputations under increasingly complex coarsening mechanisms. Particular attention is paid to clustering performance, and model selection outcomes. The results showed beneficial clustering performance despite observations being incomplete, and a higher probability of model selection metrics identifying the correct number of clusters compared to current alternative of case-deletion.
  The practical utility of the method is illustrated using two real datasets with distinct coarsened patterns. Analysis of the xenolith dataset identifies a four-component Dirichlet mixture that reveals interpretable profiles of rock types and speciation methods. Application to PM$_{2.5}$ speciation data from the Air Quality System, containing both left-censored and missing-at-random values, supports a four-component mixture model that characterises compositional parts of particulate matter across the United States.

</details>


### [409] [Adaptive Nyström for Gaussian Process Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27427)
*Lulu Kang*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 提出一种自适应Nyström方法，通过贪心选择地标点以最小化核近似误差的迹残差，并将地标扩展与超参数优化交替进行，在保持线性扩展的同时实现与精确GP相当的预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高斯过程回归的O(n³)计算复杂度限制了其在大规模数据上的可扩展性。低秩Nyström近似可将复杂度降至O(nm²)，但其精度高度依赖地标点的选择。现有方法多采用静态随机选择，无法随协方差结构的优化而调整，亟需一种能自适应选择地标点的方法。

Method: 提出自适应Nyström方法：(1) 采用贪心策略迭代选择地标点，每一步选择能最大程度降低核近似误差迹残差的点；(2) 将地标点扩展过程与超参数优化交替进行，使地标选择随协方差结构精化而动态适应；(3) 在五个基准测试函数上进行数值实验验证。

Result: 在五个基准函数上的实验表明，该方法在精度和稳定性上均显著优于随机地标选择；预测性能与精确GP推理相当，同时计算复杂度随样本量保持线性增长。

Conclusion: 该自适应Nyström方法为大规模计算机实验提供了一种有原则且高效的高斯过程近似框架，成功兼顾了精度与可扩展性。

Abstract: Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) is a robust framework for uncertainty quantification, yet its $O(n^3)$ complexity limits its scalability. Low-rank Nyström approximations can reduce this burden to $O(nm^2)$, but their accuracy depends heavily on the selection of landmark points. We propose an adaptive Nyström approach that greedily selects landmarks to minimize the trace residual of the kernel approximation error. Unlike static approximations, our method interleaves landmark expansion with hyperparameter optimization, allowing the selection process to adapt as the covariance structure is refined. Numerical experiments on five benchmark functions demonstrate that this method significantly outperforms random landmark selection in both accuracy and stability. It achieves predictive performance comparable to exact GP inference while maintaining linear scaling with respect to the sample size, providing a principled and efficient framework for large-scale computer experiments.

</details>


### [410] [Co-clustering of Response and Covariate Variables by Tri-Factorizing Their Non-negative Regression Coefficient Matrix](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27474)
*Kenichi Satoh,Yomei Tokuda*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种三因子非负约化秩回归方法（NMF-RRR），通过非负矩阵三因子分解对两组变量块同时进行软共聚类，并识别块间对应关系，附带交叉验证选秩和条件Wald检验用于推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在处理双块数据（如微生物组与代谢组）时，要么只对一侧聚类，要么返回带符号的因子而非聚类结果；缺少一种能同时对响应变量和协变量进行软聚类并检验块间对应关系的方法。

Method: 从多元线性回归 Y₁≈M Y₂ 出发，将非负系数矩阵 M 进行三因子分解 M = X₁ Θ X₂（tri-NMF），其中 X₁ 对响应变量软聚类，X₂ 对协变量软聚类，Θ 为块对应矩阵。采用乘法更新规则，通过交叉验证选择两个秩，并开发了在基选择后应用的条件Wald检验用于推断 Θ。

Result: 条件Wald检验在固定基下具有名义检验水准，在重估计后偏保守，在响应变量相关时略高于名义水平；非零路径的效应量以估计基为条件。在四个数据集上进行了验证，包括Doubs（群落生态学）、nutrimouse（营养基因组学，p>n）、FRANZOSA（微生物组-代谢组筛选研究，发现两个微生物群与每个代谢物模块联合关联）和Wine（分类特例）。

Conclusion: NMF-RRR作为约化秩回归家族的非负成员，借鉴NMF与PCA的关系，将低秩结构表达为基于部分的基，牺牲预测精度以换取可解释的共聚类和可检验的块对应关系。

Abstract: Two-block data---two sets of variables measured on the same individuals, such as microbial taxa and metabolites---raise the question of how \emph{groups} of covariate variables relate to \emph{groups} of response variables. Co-clustering answers this for a single matrix, not for two variable blocks; existing two-block methods either cluster only one side or return signed factors rather than clusters. Starting from the multivariate linear regression $Y_1\approx M Y_2$, we give its non-negative coefficient matrix a tri-factorization $M=X_1ΘX_2$ (a tri-NMF), so that $X_1$ softly clusters the response variables, $X_2$ the covariate variables, and $Θ$ is a tested matrix of block correspondences. This makes the method the non-negative member of the reduced-rank regression (RRR) family, expressing RRR's low-rank class in a parts-based basis as NMF relates to PCA; the constraint can only restrict the fit, so predictive accuracy is not the aim; the co-clustering and tested correspondences are. We give multiplicative update rules, choose the two ranks by cross-validation, and develop a conditional Wald test for $Θ$ applied after basis selection; its size is nominal with fixed bases, conservative after re-estimation, and slightly above nominal under correlated responses, while a non-zero path's \emph{magnitude} stays conditional on the estimated bases. We illustrate the method---a tri-factorized non-negative RRR (NMF-RRR)---on four data sets spanning a permutation structure (Doubs, community ecology), a weak cross-structure under $p>n$ (nutrimouse, nutrigenomics), a pronounced one in a screened microbiome--metabolome study (FRANZOSA, where two microbial groups are jointly associated with each metabolite module), and a classification special case (Wine).

</details>


### [411] [The Continuous Latent Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Dynamics Framework: A Scalable Latent Process Model for Multivariate Longitudinal Categorical Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27520)
*Zhennan Wu,Yijie Wang,Xiaoqing Huang*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: CLOUD框架结合IRT测量模型与多元OU动态过程，通过引入时间非齐次OU过程和可扩展漂移矩阵参数化，实现对不规则采样、多变量纵向分类数据的疾病轨迹建模，并在ALS数据上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纵向生物医学研究面临三大挑战：受试者间疾病进展高度异质；多个测量指标背后存在未观测、协同演化的潜变量；以及高度不规则的采样间隔。现有方法难以同时应对这些挑战。

Method: 提出CLOUD框架：(1)用调整自项目反应理论(IRT)的测量组件将多元分类观测链接到潜在功能域；(2)用多元OU过程刻画潜在功能域的耦合时间演化；(3)引入时间非齐次OU过程，在漂移均值函数中融入协变量依赖成分；(4)提出可扩展的OU漂移矩阵参数化，支持无限制潜在域数量的有效交互建模。同时建立了模型解析可处理性、漂移矩阵重参数化的一般性和整体可识别性的理论性质。

Result: 模拟研究和ALS临床数据应用表明，CLOUD能够有效刻画受试者特异性的疾病演化轨迹，捕捉多个交互功能域之间的耦合动态，在处理不规则采样间隔和异质进展方面表现优越。

Conclusion: CLOUD为从多元纵向分类数据中建模复杂疾病轨迹提供了一个原则性强且灵活的工具，能够刻画个体在多交互功能域上的疾病演变。

Abstract: Longitudinal biomedical studies increasingly collect irregularly sampled, multivariate categorical data that imperfectly reflect disease progression. This presents three key analytical challenges: highly heterogeneous disease progression across subjects; the presence of unobserved, co-evolving latent variables driving multiple measurements; and highly irregular sampling intervals both within and across patients. To address those challenges, we present the Continuous Latent Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Dynamics (CLOUD) framework for modeling complex disease trajectories from multivariate longitudinal categorical data. CLOUD links multivariate categorical observations to underlying latent functional domains and characterizes their coupled temporal evolution via the integration of a measurement component adjusted from item response theory (IRT) with a dynamic component based on multivariate Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) processes. Methodologically, we introduce a time-inhomogeneous OU process that incorporated covariate-dependent components into the shifting mean function of the latent dynamics, allowing baseline biomarkers to modulate individual-level disease trajectories. We further propose a scalable parameterization of the OU drift matrix that enabled valid interaction modeling without restricting the number of latent functional domains. We establish theoretical properties of the proposed framework, including the analytical tractability of the model, the generality of the drift matrix reparameterization, and the identifiability of the entire model. Through simulation studies and an application to longitudinal amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) clinical data, we demonstrate that CLOUD provided a principled and flexible tool for characterizing subject-specific disease evolution across multiple interacting functional domains.

</details>


### [412] [Towards Best Practices for Covariate Adjustment in Regulatory Trials: From Fixed to Data-Adaptive Approaches](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27542)
*Laura B. Balzer,Lei Nie,Issa J. Dahabreh,Kajsa Kvist,Tianyue Zhou,Demissie Alemayehu,Larry Han,Zhiwei Zhang,Salina P. Waddy,Andrew Mertens,Christian B. Pipper,Ken Wiley,,Margot Yann,Gilmer Valdes,Xu Shi,Mark van der Laan,Maya Petersen,Kelly Van Lancker*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文讨论了随机试验中协变量调整的方法学进展，重点比较了未调整估计、固定协变量调整和数据自适应（机器学习）调整三种方法。作者倡导采用预先设定、透明可重复、对模型误设定稳健的数据自适应协变量调整方法，以在保持统计有效性的同时提高估计精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FDA近期指南支持使用参数回归模型进行固定协变量调整以提高精度，但未涉及更灵活的数据自适应或机器学习方法。当前存在方法学空白：如何在保证统计有效性和因果推断的前提下，利用数据自适应方法进一步提升随机试验的估计精度。作者希望推动学界对原则性、预先设定的数据自适应协变量调整方法的讨论与接受。

Method: 本文为方法论视角文章（perspective），非原创实证研究。作者提供了非技术性综述，系统比较了三类效应估计方法：(1) 未调整估计量；(2) 基于参数回归的固定协变量调整；(3) 数据自适应/机器学习协变量调整。提出了实施数据自适应调整的实践建议框架，强调需满足：预先完全设定、透明可重复实施、对模型误设定稳健、保证相对未调整分析的精度提升，同时保持统计有效性和目标因果效应的不变性。

Result: 作者论证指出，在结局缺失最少的随机试验中估计目标人群的平均处理效应时，适当实施的数据自适应协变量调整可以：(1) 保证优于未调整分析的精度；(2) 在模型误设定情况下保持稳健性；(3) 维持统计有效性；(4) 不改变所估计的因果效应目标。这些性质在满足完全预先设定和透明实施等条件下可以同时实现。

Conclusion: 原则性的、预先设定的数据自适应协变量调整应当被更广泛地接受和应用。该方法在保持统计严谨性的同时，能够比传统未调整分析或固定参数调整提供更高的精度。作者呼吁扩大该领域的讨论并推动监管和实践层面的接纳。

Abstract: While randomization justifies the use of unadjusted effect estimators in randomized trials, there is growing interest in covariate adjustment to improve precision. Adjusting for baseline variables that are prognostic of the outcome can reduce estimator variance, resulting in narrower confidence intervals and increased statistical power. Recent guidance by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration supports fixed adjustment for prognostic covariates using parametric regression models. However, this guidance does not address more flexible approaches using data-adaptive or machine learning methods. We offer our perspectives on covariate adjustment to improve analytic precision. We focus on estimating the average effect for the target population in trials with minimal outcome missingness. We provide a non-technical overview of effect estimators that are unadjusted and effect estimators using fixed versus data-adaptive adjustment. We offer practical suggestions for conducting adjusted analyses that are data-adaptive, fully pre-specified, transparently and reproducibly implemented, robust to model misspecification, and guaranteed to improve precision relative to unadjusted analyses --- all while preserving statistical validity and the causal effect of interest. We hope that sharing our perspectives will foster broader discussion and eventual acceptance of principled, pre-specified, data-adaptive covariate adjustment in randomized trials.

</details>


### [413] [Asymptotic emergence of statistically supported false causal interpretation under unmeasured confounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27593)
*Mark Louie F. Ramos*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文从渐近角度刻画了未测量混杂对数据驱动因果发现的影响：当真实原因不可观测而仅存在相关代理变量时，增大样本量虽能提高对代理变量间关联的确定性，却无法保证恢复真实的因果结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未测量混杂在观测因果推断中的局限性虽被广泛认识，但其对数据驱动因果发现的具体影响常被低估。作者旨在从渐近理论层面严格界定这一局限，揭示统计不确定性与因果机制之间的根本区别。

Method: 采用渐近理论分析框架：假设真实因果变量不可观测，仅可获取与之相关的代理变量。在此设定下，分析当样本量趋于无穷、同时追求越来越稳定的数据驱动因果结构时，代理变量间关联的行为特征。

Result: 随着样本量增大，可观测代理变量之间的虚假关联会变得越来越"确定"，即统计不确定性降低，但这一确定性并不等同于因果结构的正确识别——真实因果机制仍可能无法被恢复。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了一个根本性区分：更多数据能够提升对观测变量空间内真实关系的确定性，却无法保证识别底层因果结构。这提醒研究者在数据驱动因果发现中，不能将统计置信度等同于因果正确性。

Abstract: Unmeasured confounding is widely recognized as a limitation of observational causal inference, but its implications for data-driven causal discovery are often understated. We provide an asymptotic characterization of this limitation. When the true causal variable is unobserved but correlated proxy variables are available, increasing sample size while searching for increasingly stable, data-driven causal structures will make associations involving observable proxies become increasingly certain. This result highlights a fundamental distinction between reducing statistical uncertainty and recovering causal mechanisms: more data can improve certainty about genuine relationships within the observed variable space while providing no guarantee of identifying the underlying causal structure.

</details>


### [414] [Doubly Robust Estimators of Quantile Treatment Effects With Semiparametric Cumulative Probability Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27633)
*Hao Wu,Chun Li,Bryan E. Shepherd*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于累积概率模型（CPM）的双重稳健分位数处理效应（QTE）估计框架，针对存在检测下限的偏态HIV研究数据，开发了两种估计策略（逆CDF法和直接法），并扩展至概率处理效应，同时验证了经验夹心估计量和非参数bootstrap在方差估计中的双重稳健性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统因果推断聚焦于潜在结果均值估计，但生物医学研究中（如HIV研究），结局变量常呈偏态分布且存在检测下限，此时分位数处理效应（QTE）能捕捉分布差异。然而现有QTE方法依赖分布假设，对模型误设敏感，亟需一种不依赖强分布假设的稳健估计框架。

Method: 基于累积概率模型（CPM）这一秩基半参数线性变换模型，提出双重稳健QTE估计框架：策略一（逆CDF法）利用有效影响函数（EIF）先估计潜在结果的边际CDF，再通过加权分位数插值反演分布获得边际分位数；策略二（直接法）直接求解潜在边际分位数的EIF。框架进一步扩展至概率处理效应（PTE）及条件PTE。方差估计方面，考察了EIF估计量、夹心估计量和非参数bootstrap三种方法。

Result: 所提估计量具备双重稳健性和渐近正态性。模拟研究表明，经验夹心估计量和非参数bootstrap在冗余模型误设下提供双重稳健的方差估计，并具有稳定的有限样本表现。蒙特卡洛模拟和HIV数据应用验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 提出的CPM基双重稳健框架可有效估计QTE和PTE，不依赖强分布假设，对模型误设具有鲁棒性，尤其适用于偏态分布和存在检测下限的生物医学数据，为HIV等研究中的处理效应分布分析提供了可靠工具。

Abstract: The causal inference literature has traditionally focused on estimating the mean of the potential outcome, whereas evaluating how a treatment affects the entire outcome distribution can provide additional information in biomedical research. Quantile treatment effect (QTE) captures such distributional differences, particularly when outcomes are skewed. However, existing approaches for estimating QTE make distributional assumptions about the outcome and are thus sensitive to model misspecification. Motivated by an HIV study with skewed outcomes, one of which is subject to detection limits, we propose a doubly robust framework for estimating QTE based on the cumulative probability model (CPM), which is a rank-based, semiparametric linear transformation model. We develop two CPM-based estimation strategies: (1) an inverse-cumulative distribution function (CDF) approach that first estimates the marginal CDF of potential outcomes using the efficient influence function (EIF) and then obtains marginal quantiles via weighted quantile interpolation by inverting the distribution, and (2) a direct approach that solves the EIF of potential marginal quantiles. The proposed estimators are doubly robust and asymptotically normal. We further extend the framework to probability treatment effects (PTEs) and their conditional counterparts. For statistical inference, we investigate several variance estimation procedures, including EIF-based estimators, sandwich estimators, and the nonparametric bootstrap. Simulation studies illustrate that the empirical sandwich estimator and the nonparametric bootstrap provide doubly robust variance estimation with stable finite-sample performance under nuisance model misspecification. The proposed methods are evaluated through extensive Monte Carlo simulations and illustrated using an HIV data application.

</details>


### [415] [Mediation Analysis with Multiple Mediators Subject to Missing Not at Random](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27669)
*Yanfei Jin,Shanshan Luo,Xueli Wang,Zhi Geng*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文研究了多个中介变量存在非随机缺失（MNAR）时的因果中介分析，提出了一类广泛的MNAR机制下的识别与估计框架，将传统中介分析推广至不可忽略缺失情形，并通过模拟和NHANES数据验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多个中介变量的中介分析方法通常假设数据完全观测或随机缺失（MAR），当缺失机制为非随机缺失（MNAR）时会导致有偏估计。然而实践中缺失往往依赖于未观测的中介变量本身，需要发展能够处理不可忽略缺失中介变量的新方法。

Method: 作者考虑了一类广泛的MNAR机制，允许缺失依赖于未观测的中介变量、处理、协变量和结果。在此框架下，建立了自然直接效应和间接效应的可识别性条件，并将传统中介分析推广至不可忽略缺失情形。基于识别框架，提出了相应的估计方法，通过模拟研究评估有限样本表现，并应用于NHANES数据。

Result: 模拟研究表明，所提方法在多种缺失场景下均表现出令人满意的有限样本性能。NHANES数据的实际应用展示了该方法在不可忽略缺失数据条件下研究中介路径的实用价值。

Conclusion: 本文成功将因果中介分析扩展至多个中介变量存在MNAR缺失的场景，建立了系统的识别与估计框架，为存在不可忽略缺失数据的实证研究提供了可靠的分析工具。

Abstract: Causal mediation analysis serves as a key tool for uncovering the mediating mechanisms linking treatments to outcomes. Existing methods for mediation analysis with multiple mediators typically assume complete observations or missing-at-random and may yield biased estimation when mediator values are missing not at random (MNAR). This paper studies the identification and estimation of causal mediation effects with multiple mediators subject to MNAR missingness. We consider a broad class of MNAR mechanisms in which missingness may depend on unobserved mediators, treatment, covariates, and outcomes. Under a series of increasingly general MNAR mechanisms, we establish identified natural direct and indirect effects, effectively generalizing existing mediation analysis to handle nonignorable missing mediators. Based on the proposed identification framework, we develop estimation procedures for causal mediation effects and evaluate their finite-sample performance through simulation studies. The results demonstrate satisfactory performance across a range of missingness scenarios. An application to data from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey(NHANES) illustrates the practical utility of the proposed methodology for investigating mediation pathways in the presence of nonignorable missing data.

</details>


### [416] [A Bayesian Bootstrap Method for Survival Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27678)
*K Shuvo Bakar,Armando Teixeira-Pinto*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种将贝叶斯bootstrap与广义贝叶斯更新相结合的生存分析方法，通过Dirichlet权重实现非参数抽样不确定性刻画，并利用损失函数融入先验信息，具有模型无关性，在Cox比例风险模型上展示了稳健的不确定性量化效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统贝叶斯生存分析方法需要指定完整的概率似然，对分布假设敏感且计算量大；在存在删失、小样本和异质性人群的情况下，不确定性量化具有挑战性，需要一种更灵活且稳健的贝叶斯方法。

Method: 提出两步框架：(1) 贝叶斯bootstrap阶段，通过Dirichlet权重生成生存估计量的分布，非参数化地刻画抽样不确定性；(2) 广义贝叶斯（Gibbs）更新阶段，利用损失函数在广义贝叶斯框架下融入模型参数的先验信息，得到后验分布推断。该方法与具体模型无关，可适用于广泛的生存估计量类别。

Result: 以Cox比例风险模型为例开发了具体框架，模拟研究表明该方法能提供稳健的不确定性量化并有效融入先验信息，在右删失生存数据上的应用验证了其实用性，并开发了开源R包BayesBoots。

Conclusion: 所提出的方法成功地将贝叶斯bootstrap与广义贝叶斯更新相结合，为生存分析提供了一种模型无关、计算可行且对分布假设不敏感的贝叶斯推断框架，兼顾了非参数灵活性和先验信息整合能力。

Abstract: Survival analysis is widely used for analyzing time-to-event data, and often uncertainty quantification remains challenging in the presence of censoring, limited sample sizes, and heterogeneous populations. Existing Bayesian survival methods provide a framework for incorporating prior information but typically require specification of a full probabilistic likelihood, making inference sensitive to distributional assumptions and sometimes computationally demanding. We propose a Bayesian approach for survival analysis that combines the Bayesian bootstrap with generalized Bayesian (Gibbs) updating. The Bayesian bootstrap first generates a distribution over survival estimators through Dirichlet weights, providing a nonparametric characterization of sampling uncertainty. Prior information for model parameter is then incorporated using a loss function within the generalized Bayesian framework, yielding an inference for posterior distribution. The proposed methodology is model-agnostic and can be applied to a broad class of survival estimators. As an illustration, we develop the framework for the Cox proportional hazards model, producing posterior inference for regression coefficients while preserving the familiar properties and interpretation of hazard ratios. Simulation studies demonstrate that the proposed approach provides robust uncertainty quantification and effectively incorporates prior information. An application to right-censored survival data further illustrates its practical utility. An open-source R package, BayesBoots, implements the proposed methodology.

</details>


### [417] [On regression with estimated covariates and conditional effects given the propensity score](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27685)
*Jiaqi Wu,Matteo Bonvini,Edward H. Kennedy,Jennie E. Brand,Yu Xie*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文研究当某些协变量需在第一阶段估计时，如何进行非参数回归。针对Brand & Xie (2010)提出的教育异质性回报问题，作者分析了两种去偏方法——基于影响函数的估计和偏差校正的插件估计，推导了误差上界和达到oracle速率的条件，并通过模拟和NLSY97数据验证了方法有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Brand & Xie (2010)研究大学教育对收入的影响如何随个体完成大学教育的（未知）概率而变化。当使用估计的倾向得分等协变量进行第二阶段非参数回归时，简单的插件估计会因第一阶段估计误差导致偏差。本文旨在提出通用的去偏框架，以缓解这一问题。

Method: 作者在一个对第一阶段估计方法不设限的框架下，分析了两种去偏方法：(i) 基于影响函数的估计，针对路径可微的参数逼近目标估计量；(ii) 直接校正插件估计偏差的变体方法。第二阶段可采用局部平滑或筛基（sieve）方法。对每种方法，作者推导了估计误差的上界，并刻画了逼近oracle速率的条件。

Result: 理论结果表明，两种去偏方法在适当条件下均可逼近oracle收敛速率，相比简单插件估计有显著提升。模拟研究验证了有限样本下的良好表现。在NLSY97数据的应用中，发现完成大学教育对失业率的降低作用在那些最不可能完成大学教育的个体中最为显著，这与Brand & Xie (2010)及Brand (2023)的早期发现一致。

Conclusion: 本文提出的去偏框架能有效处理生成回归元（generated regressors）带来的第一阶段估计误差问题，在非参数回归设定下获得更优的收敛速率。实证结果进一步支持了教育回报异质性文献的核心发现：大学教育的收益对于边际学生（即完成大学教育倾向最低的群体）最大。

Abstract: Motivated by the study of heterogeneous returns to education in Brand & Xie 2010, which considers how the effect of completing college on earnings varies with the (unknown) probability of completing college, we analyze the problem of estimating a nonparametric regression function when certain covariates are estimated in a first step. Plug-in estimators that treat the estimated covariates as known generally suffer from first-stage estimation error. To mitigate this issue, we analyze two debiasing approaches within a framework that is agnostic to the choice of the first-stage estimation method and relies on either local-smoothing or sieve-based methods for the second-stage regression. In particular, we consider: (i) influence function-based estimators of pathwise differentiable parameters that approximate the target estimand, and (ii) a variant of plug-in estimators that directly aims to correct their bias. For each method, we upper bound the estimation error and characterize conditions under which oracle rates can be approached, highlighting the possible gains in terms of convergence rates relative to the plug-ins. Simulation studies illustrate the finite-sample behavior of the methods. We apply our methodology to data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1997 and find evidence that completing college yields the largest reductions in unemployment for individuals least likely to do so, consistent with earlier findings in the literature (Brand & Xie 2010; Brand 2023).

</details>


### [418] [On Graph-Informed Distance Metrics for Comparing Graph Partitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27689)
*Srijato Bhattacharyya,Huiyan Sang,Bani Mallick*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种图信息感知的图划分比较框架，通过诱导边划分构造有效的距离度量（如图信息版的变分信息和van Dongen距离），并在随机块模型下证明拓扑扰动越大则距离越大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图划分比较方法多采用图无关的指标，将顶点视为可交换的，忽略了编码社区凝聚与分离信息的底层图拓扑结构，因此需要一种能够尊重图结构的划分距离度量。

Method: 作者提出一种通用构造方法：通过顶点划分诱导边划分，基于边划分定义图信息感知的距离。具体构造了图信息版的变分信息（VI）、van Dongen距离以及一种基于割的二元伴随距离，并证明这些距离满足局部图感知精化准则。进一步在随机块模型下进行理论分析。

Result: 所提出的距离在连续图划分空间上构成有效度量，并满足局部图感知精化准则。在随机块模型下，证明了在社区间和社区内分裂两种情形下，更强的拓扑扰动几乎必然导致渐近更大的距离。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了一个简洁且具有原则性的方法来比较图划分，同时充分尊重底层图结构，填补了现有图划分比较方法忽视拓扑信息的空白。

Abstract: Comparing graph partitions is fundamental to the analysis of network-structured data, yet existing measures for comparing graph partitions typically rely on graph-agnostic indices that treat vertices as exchangeable, ignoring the underlying graph topology that encodes essential information about community cohesion and separation. We propose a general construction of graph-informed distances that compares vertex partitions through induced edge partitions and yields valid metrics on the space of contiguous graph partitions. As special cases, we develop graph-informed versions of variation of information and the van Dongen distance together with a binary cut-based companion distance, and show that these distances satisfy a natural local graph-aware refinement criterion. Under stochastic block models, we prove that stronger topological disruptions incur asymptotically larger distances almost surely in both inter-community and intra-community split settings. These results provide a simple and principled framework to compare graph partitions while respecting the underlying graph structure.

</details>


### [419] [Evaluating Algorithm-Assisted Human Decision-Making Over Repeated Algorithm Exposure: Recommendations for Effect Estimands and Experimental Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27701)
*Maggie Wang,Michael Baiocchi*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文针对算法辅助人类决策的情境，提出了新的效应估计量来刻画人在重复接触算法过程中的行为适应，并设计了最小化最大步进双楔形试验方案，相较于传统设计能更有效且无偏地估计这些目标量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在高风险决策（如医疗）中，算法辅助工具对决策质量的影响需通过随机试验评估。然而，现有试验设计与分析忽略了人在重复接触算法时行为会动态适应（如自动化偏差、警报疲劳、校准依赖），导致传统方法无法准确刻画算法辅助的真实效果。

Method: 首先定义了一组能刻画重复暴露下行为适应的效应估计量（target estimands），并论证其理论价值。随后提出一种最小化最大步进双楔形设计（minimax stepped double wedge design），专门用于估计这些估计量。最后通过与历史随机试验中常见的两种替代设计进行对比，在三类真实世界行为动态模型下评估各设计的估计偏差。

Result: 所提出的步进双楔形设计能够有效估计目标效应量；而两种常见替代设计不仅难以估计这些目标量，且在自动化偏差、警报疲劳和校准依赖三种行为适应模式下均产生有偏估计。

Conclusion: 评估算法辅助效果时必须考虑人类行为的动态适应，传统的试验设计对此存在系统性缺陷。本文提出的估计量框架与配套的步进双楔形设计为更准确地理解算法辅助的真实影响提供了方法论基础。

Abstract: In algorithm-assisted decision-making in high-stakes settings like healthcare, an algorithmic decision support tool provides a recommendation, but the human ultimately makes the decision. Determining whether algorithm assistance actually improves the quality of human decision-making prior to deployment is critical, and randomized experiments are one way to collect robust evidence. Historically, however, experimental designs and analyses ignore how decision-making behavior adapts with repeated algorithm exposure. In this work, we define a set of effect estimands that account for and characterize human behavior adaptation under repeated exposure and justify why these estimands are useful to target for developing a better understanding of the impact of algorithm assistance. We propose a minimax stepped double wedge design that facilitates estimating these target estimands. Finally, we compare our proposed design to two common alternative designs identified through a review of historical randomized trials of algorithm assistance. We show that these designs are less amenable to estimating the target estimands and produce biased estimates under three different forms of behavioral adaptation inspired by dynamics observed in the real world -- automation bias, alert fatigue, and calibrated reliance.

</details>


### [420] [A Mathematical Framework for Topological Causal Data Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28161)
*Hugo Gobato Souto,Ioannis Diamantis*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出拓扑因果数据分析(TCDA)框架，将观测空间、因果模型类、拓扑表示与因果查询分离，在因果假设给定后利用拓扑学提供形状敏感的稳定摘要，区分结果层面和分布层面的TCDA，并讨论识别、双重稳健表示、稳定性迁移及拓扑在因果发现中的辅助但非识别作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代数据(图像、点云、网络、空间场等)多为结构化对象，传统个体处理效应差异 \(Y^1-Y^0\) 可能无定义或不具科学意义，需要新的框架来对这类复杂结构数据进行因果分析。

Method: 提出TCDA框架，将问题解耦为四层：观测空间、因果模型类、拓扑表示、因果查询。结果层面TCDA通过Banach空间值摘要的识别与双重稳健表示处理个体潜在结果变换；分布层面TCDA利用g-formula识别干预结果分布，建立稳定性迁移界与插件一致性，并引入目标特定拓扑可忽略性以在不完全识别干预分布的情况下识别协变量标准化的粗效应。

Result: 在结果层面给出Banach空间值摘要的识别条件与双重稳健表示；在分布层面通过g-formula实现目标识别，导出稳定性迁移界和插件一致性；阐明目标特定拓扑可忽略性允许在无需完全识别干预分布时进行协变量标准化粗效应识别；证明观测拓扑在因果发现中仅起辅助诊断作用，无法独自识别因果结构。

Conclusion: TCDA成功将拓扑数据分析与因果推断结合，拓扑学不定义干预而是提供因果假设之后的形状敏感摘要。框架厘清了结果层面与分布层面分析的异同，明确了拓扑在因果发现中的边界——仅可在受限模型类中辅助诊断，不能取代因果结构识别。

Abstract: Many modern outcomes, including images, point clouds, networks, and spatial fields, are structured objects for which \(Y^1-Y^0\) may be undefined or scientifically inadequate. We introduce \emph{Topological Causal Data Analysis} (TCDA), a framework separating the observation space, causal-model class, topological representation, and causal query. Topology does not define interventions; it supplies stable, shape-sensitive summaries after causal assumptions have been specified. We distinguish outcome-level TCDA, which transforms individual potential outcomes, from distribution-level TCDA, which transforms interventional outcome laws, and characterize when outcome and distribution level contrasts agree. Building on recent outcome-level theory, we formulate identification and doubly robust representations for Banach-space-valued summaries. At the distribution level, we identify targets through the standard causal \(g\)-formula and derive stability-transfer bounds and plug-in consistency. We also place target-specific topological ignorability within the framework, clarifying when a covariate-standardized coarse effect can be identified without identifying the full interventional laws. Finally, we delimit the role of observational topology in causal discovery: it can assist diagnosis on restricted model classes but cannot by itself identify causal structure.

</details>


### [421] [Bias Correction of Long-memory Estimator of Functional Time Series via the Prefiltered Sieve Bootstrap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28177)
*Chang Liu,Han Lin Shang*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文研究基于筛式自助法（sieve bootstrap）的偏差校正程序，用于估计平稳或非平稳分数阶积分过程中的长记忆参数d。该方法对经初步长记忆参数估计预过滤后的数据实施筛式自助法，推荐使用LPWN估计量作为初始估计以减少偏差，筛式自助法还能提供参数置信区间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长记忆参数d的估计中，常用的局部Whittle估计或去趋势波动分析（DFA）估计量在存在强短期自回归依赖性时存在显著偏差，需要一种偏差校正方法来改善估计精度。

Method: 采用筛式自助法进行偏差校正：首先使用Frederiksen等人(2012)提出的局部多项式Whittle含噪声（LPWN）估计量对数据进行预过滤，获得长记忆参数的初步估计；然后在此预过滤数据上实施筛式自助法重抽样，从而校正偏差并构建置信区间。

Result: 模拟研究表明，局部Whittle和DFA估计量存在明显偏差；LPWN估计量本身能减少偏差，再结合筛式自助法增强后可进一步改善偏差。筛式自助法还能同时提供记忆参数的置信区间。

Conclusion: 基于LPWN初始估计的筛式自助法偏差校正程序能有效减少长记忆参数估计中的偏差，尤其在强短期自回归依赖情形下表现优越，且兼具区间估计功能。

Abstract: We investigate a bias correction procedure based on sieve bootstrapping to estimate the long-memory parameter d in stationary or nonstationary fractionally integrated processes. The resampling method implements a sieve bootstrap method on data prefiltered by a preliminary estimate of the long-memory parameter. For the initial estimate, we recommend the local polynomial Whittle with noise (LPWN) estimator in Frederiksen et al. (2012) to reduce bias, especially in the presence of a strong short-range autoregressive dependence. Through a series of simulation studies, we first highlight the issue of bias, using the local Whittle or detrended fluctuation analysis estimator. Then, we consider the LPWN estimator and show the potential improvement in bias achieved by its sieve bootstrap enhancement. As a byproduct, the sieve bootstrap can also provide confidence intervals of the memory parameter.

</details>


### [422] [Non-partitioned e-detectors for nonparametric sequential change detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28322)
*Aytijhya Saha,Aaditya Ramdas*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文研究在一般概率分布类上的序贯变点检测问题，其中变化前后的分布均未知且属于同一分布族。作者提出一类基于聚合点零e-process的通用序贯检测方法，通过在不同候选无变化分布上取下确界实现检测，并证明该方法在适当条件下可实现一阶渐近最优检测延迟，同时保证平均运行长度(ARL)或虚警概率(PFA)控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的序贯变点检测方法通常需要预先指定变化前和变化后的分布族划分，而现实场景中往往难以事先获知这种划分。本研究的动机是开发一种无需预先划分分布族的通用框架，使得在变化前后分布均未知且同属一个一般分布类的情况下，仍能有效进行序贯检测。

Method: 提出了一类通用的序贯变点检测器：1）通过在可能的变点位置上聚合点零e-process（point-null e-processes）构建检测统计量；2）在候选的无变化分布上取下确界（infimum）；3）聚合方案中的权重决定了检测器实现的是ARL控制还是PFA控制；4）在适当假设下证明方法的理论性质。

Result: 在适当假设条件下，所提方法实现了以下核心结果：1）一阶渐近最优的检测延迟（first-order asymptotically optimal detection delay）；2）可根据权重选择实现平均运行长度(ARL)控制或虚警概率(PFA)控制。具体示例包括亚高斯与有界均值变化、未知方差的高斯均值变化，以及马尔可夫转移矩阵变化等场景。

Conclusion: 该研究成功构建了一个无需预先划分分布族的通用序贯变点检测框架，兼具理论最优性和实际灵活性。通过聚合e-process和取下确界的技术路线，方法可广泛适用于多种分布族和变化类型，为序贯变点检测提供了一个统一且有效的解决方案。

Abstract: We study the problem of sequential change detection over a general class of probability distributions ($\mathcal P$), where both the pre-change and post-change distributions are unknown and belong to $\mathcal P$. We do not assume a pre-specified partition of $\mathcal P$ into pre- and post-change families. We propose a general class of sequential change detectors obtained by aggregating point-null e-processes over possible changepoints and taking an infimum over candidate no-change distributions. The weights in the aggregation scheme determine whether they attain average run length (ARL) control and probability-of-false-alarm (PFA) control. Under suitable assumptions, we prove that our methods achieve first-order asymptotically optimal detection delay. Concrete examples include sub-Gaussian and bounded mean changes, Gaussian mean changes with unknown variance, as well as changes in Markov transition matrices.

</details>


### [423] [An Interval-Score ROC Curve for Assessment, Calibration and Ensembling of Probabilistic Forecasts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28178)
*Simone Milanesi,Marco Capelletti,Flavio Bobba,Giuseppe De Nicolao*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出IS-ROC曲线框架，将概率预报评估从单一标量扩展为刻画预报集中度与准确性权衡的Pareto前沿，并基于几何特性发展了切线优化校准、凸化及凸包集成策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有恰当评分规则将预报性能压缩为单一标量，掩盖了预报集中度（tightness）与预测准确性之间的多目标权衡，缺乏刻画完整区间预报族的图形化工具。

Method: 引入区间得分接收者操作特征（IS-ROC）曲线，将不同预报紧度下的区间预报族映射为二维图形；证明数据生成过程诱导的IS-ROC曲线具有Pareto最优性和凸性；基于此几何特性提出切线优化与凸化的校准方法，以及通过凸包构造的预报集成策略。

Result: IS-ROC曲线为最优预报前沿提供了几何表征；基于几何的校准和集成方法在数值示例中得到验证，能有效进行预报比较、校准和集成。

Conclusion: IS-ROC曲线框架实现了概率预报评估从标量到多目标Pareto前沿的范式转换，为预报校准与集成提供了几何直观且理论有保障的新工具。

Abstract: Probabilistic forecast evaluation is inherently multi-objective, yet existing proper scoring rules reduce predictive performance to a single scalar value, potentially obscuring the trade-off between forecast concentration and predictive accuracy. We introduce the Interval-Score Receiver Operating Characteristic (IS-ROC) Curve, a graphical framework that represents the complete family of interval forecasts generated by varying prediction tightness. We show that the IS-ROC Curve induced by the data generating process is Pareto optimal and convex, providing a geometric characterization of the optimal forecasting frontier. Building on these properties, we propose a geometry-based calibration procedure based on tangent optimization and convexification, together with an ensemble strategy that combines competing forecasters through convex hull construction. Finally, we provide a practical workflow and numerical examples illustrating forecast comparison, calibration, and ensemble construction within the proposed framework.

</details>


### [424] [Improving Discrepancy Measures for Global Sensitivity Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28252)
*Samuele Lo Piano,Alessio Lachi,Razi Sheikholeslami,Arnald Puy,Pamphile Tupui Roy,Andrea Saltelli*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出一种改进的ersatz discrepancy度量，通过对输出进行秩转换、网格化以及利用Moore邻域插补空单元，使其与Sobol'总阶指数高度一致。作者通过copula理论证明了该方法作为筛选统计量的一致性、零条件和上限，并指出了纯交互依赖下的失效模式。在七个基准函数和一个水文模型上的基准测试表明，该方法在非平滑输出上实现了完美的秩一致性，优于PCE、PCE-Shapley和PAWN等估计器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Sobol'总阶指数虽理论基础扎实但计算成本高昂，而现有ersatz discrepancy虽成本低却缺乏理论依据，且未与其他数据驱动估计器进行系统基准比较。

Method: 对原始ersatz discrepancy进行两项关键改进：(1) 在网格化前对输出做秩转换；(2) 通过Moore邻域规则对孤立空单元进行插补。利用copula理论证明其作为筛选统计量的一致性、零条件、全支撑上限以及纯交互依赖失效模式。与PCE、PCE-Shapley和PAWN型KS指数在七个基准函数和一个水文模型上进行基准比较，并对五个算法参数进行联合敏感性分析。

Result: 调整后的ersatz是唯一在PCE设定错误的水文非平滑输出上实现完美秩一致的估计器。网格分辨率（而非插补阈值或采样方法）是驱动性能变异的主要参数。

Conclusion: 调整后的ersatz discrepancy是一种兼具计算效率与理论基础的有效敏感性筛选工具，特别适用于复杂物理系统模型中PCE设定错误的场景，但其在纯交互依赖下存在已知失效模式，且不适用于精确量化效应大小。

Abstract: Sensitivity analysis methods based on Sobol' total-order indices ($T_i$) are well-founded but computationally demanding. A recently proposed ersatz discrepancy measure offers a cheaper alternative by quantifying deviations from uniformity in input--output scatterplots, yet lacks theoretical grounding and has not been benchmarked against other data-given estimators. We introduce an adjusted ersatz discrepancy that rank-transforms the output before gridding and imputes isolated empty cells via a Moore-neighbourhood rule, substantially improving agreement with $T_i$. We prove, via a copula-theoretic argument, that the adjustment is a consistent screening statistic with a zero condition, an explicit full-support ceiling bounding its use as a magnitude estimator, and a documented failure mode for purely interaction-mediated dependencies. We benchmark the adjusted ersatz against three zero-extra-cost comparators -- polynomial chaos expansion (PCE), PCE-derived Shapley effects, and a PAWN-type maximum Kolmogorov--Smirnov index -- across seven benchmark functions and a real-world hydrological model. The adjusted ersatz is the only estimator achieving perfect rank agreement on a non-smooth hydrological output where PCE is misspecified. A joint sensitivity analysis of five algorithmic parameters shows grid resolution, not the imputation threshold or sampling method, drives performance variability.

</details>


### [425] [A Novel Approach to Instrumental Variable Estimation: TEAM-IV](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28289)
*Steven Y. Alberding,Patrick J. Breheny*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: TEAM-IV是一种新的稳健工具变量方法，通过识别并聚合"联合有效"的工具子集（团队）来进行估计，即使在仅有少数候选工具（少至两个）有效的情况下也能可靠工作，在模拟和MESA实证研究中优于sisVIVE和CIIV。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稳健IV方法（如sisVIVE和CIIV）依赖多数有效性或多数-有效性条件，在无效工具普遍存在时表现不佳。需要一种即使只有少数工具有效也能可靠估计的方法。

Method: TEAM-IV对重叠工具子集拟合MCP惩罚模型（结果变量对投影暴露回归），通过观察哪些工具的估计直接效应频繁地一同被收缩至零来识别候选"团队"。团队通过样本外预测性能排序，将接近最优的团队取并集作为最终工具集进行IV估计。

Result: 在多种模拟设置（改变无效直接效应的数量、幅度和符号、工具相关性及暴露内生性）中，TEAM-IV的绝对估计误差普遍低于sisVIVE和CIIV，尤其在无效工具普遍时优势最大。在MESA数据的孟德尔随机化应用及两项验证研究中得到实证验证。

Conclusion: TEAM-IV通过"联合有效性"策略克服了传统多数/多数有效性条件的局限，在无效工具比例高时仍能提供可靠的因果效应估计，为工具变量分析提供了更稳健的替代方案。

Abstract: Instrumental-variable (IV) analyses can be undermined when some instruments violate the exclusion restriction through direct effects on the outcome. Existing robust IV methods, including sisVIVE and CIIV, rely on majority- or plurality-validity conditions. We propose TEAM-IV, which targets joint validity by identifying sets of instruments that appear valid together and aggregating them, allowing reliable estimation even when only a small number of candidate instruments are valid (potentially as few as two). TEAM-IV fits MCP-penalized models of the outcome on projected exposure over overlapping instrument subsets. Instruments whose estimated direct effects are frequently shrunk to zero together (suggesting concordant validity status) form candidate ``teams'' (instrument sets). Teams are ranked by their out-of-sample predictive performance; near-best teams are unioned and used as the instrument set for the IV estimate. Across simulations varying the number, magnitude, and signs of invalid direct effects, instrument correlation, and exposure endogeneity, TEAM-IV generally attains lower absolute estimation error than sisVIVE and CIIV. Relative gains are largest when invalid instruments are prevalent. TEAM-IV is demonstrated in an empirical Mendelian randomization application using the Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis (MESA) concerning the effect of LDL cholesterol on carotid intima--media thickness. Two additional MESA-anchored validation studies demonstrate differences between TEAM-IV and sisVIVE under challenging invalid-instrument configurations.

</details>


### [426] [A Riemannian Factor Model for Manifold-Valued Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28385)
*Shuo-Chieh Huang,Rong Chen,Yaqing Chen*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 提出一种黎曼因子模型（RFM），用于分析黎曼流形上的高维时间序列，在高维渐近框架下建立了载荷空间估计的收敛速率，并在Bures-Wasserstein流形和球面乘积流形上验证了有限样本表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
